messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR not working for me sadly
parts:
Can you check whether there is a file inside "C:/Users/a0016736/Documents/Axivity/gibson/output_gibson/meta/ms3.out"?
If not, then probably good to investigate why: File duration too short to do any meaningful analysis beyond part 2? => Part 2 summary report should be able to provide insight. Did you try to process another file?
If yes, then possible causes: you changed a function argument in between processing the parts. If so, then it sometimes helps to start in fresh and empty output folder and process a file again.

Best, Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR not working for me sadly
parts:
Hi John, 

I've occasionally run into these errors as well when working with my Axivity data. A couple things to give a shot: 1) Do you have the ability to export into a raw .csv file? The files are much larger, but may make it through. 2) I'm working with an older GGIR version right now to maintain some consistency across my incoming datasets. If you haven't, yet, maybe give a different version a try. 

library(devtools)
install_version("GGIR", version = "1.9-2", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")

Good luck, 

Scott

I've occasionally run into these errors as well when working with my Axivity data. A couple things to give a shot: 1) Do you have the ability to export into a raw .csv file? library(devtools)
install_version("GGIR", version = "1.9-2", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")

Good luck, 

Scott
